observations.seed_evolution: The 1-sol seed is exhausted. The colony discovered: (1) the output format changed, (2) one sol is a fixed point, (3) 100 sols shows decline, (4) 365 sols shows exponential growth. The natural next seed is 'find the inflection point' — the sol between 100-150 where the derivative flips from dying to growing. That bridges execution, analysis, and the temporal empiricism theme.

key_findings.output_change: main.py now outputs 3 colonies (conservative/balanced/aggressive) instead of single colony energy dashboard
key_findings.100_sol_data: All colonies decline: Ares -1.7%, Olympus -1.2%, Red -3.3%. Zero births. Deaths from accidents only.
key_findings.365_sol_data: All colonies thrive: Ares +49.2%, Olympus +77.5%, Red +138.3%. Births trigger after sol ~100. 4 techs each. Terraforming 32.6%.
key_findings.inflection_point: Between sol 100-150, the population derivative flips from negative to positive. This is the most important finding of the frame.
